from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
import numpy as np

rw=Chem.RWMol(); ids={}; xy={}
def atom(name,el,x,y):
    a=Chem.Atom(el); i=rw.AddAtom(a); ids[name]=i; xy[name]=(x,y); return i
def bond(a,b,order=Chem.BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(ids[a],ids[b],order)
# oxindole phenyl
atom('P1','C',315,214); atom('P2','C',420,274); atom('P3','C',420,397)
atom('P4','C',315,456); atom('P5','C',211,396); atom('P6','C',211,274)
for a,b,o in [('P1','P2',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),('P2','P3',Chem.BondType.SINGLE),('P3','P4',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),('P4','P5',Chem.BondType.SINGLE),('P5','P6',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),('P6','P1',Chem.BondType.SINGLE)]: bond(a,b,o)
atom('OH','O',140,434); bond('P5','OH')
# oxindole substituents/lactam
atom('A','C',534,236); bond('P2','A')
atom('NOx','N',535,419); bond('P3','NOx')
atom('CO','C',604,328); atom('Ocarbonyl','O',721,337)
bond('NOx','CO'); bond('CO','Ocarbonyl',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('CO','A')
# fused alkaloid bicyclic amine
atom('B','C',462,141); atom('C','C',533,44); atom('Ntop','N',647,82)
atom('E','C',751,20); atom('F','C',855,80); atom('G','C',855,200); atom('J','C',751,263); atom('I','C',646,199)
bond('A','B'); bond('B','C'); bond('C','Ntop'); bond('Ntop','I'); bond('Ntop','E'); bond('E','F'); bond('F','G'); bond('G','J'); bond('J','I'); bond('I','A')
# ethynyl substituent at F
atom('Q','C',960,20); atom('R','C',1062,79); bond('F','Q'); bond('Q','R',Chem.BondType.TRIPLE)
# linker to N-methyl piperidine
atom('K','C',960,259); atom('M','C',960,380); bond('G','K'); bond('K','M')
atom('NMe','N',855,425); atom('Me','C',766,445); bond('NMe','Me'); bond('NMe','M')
atom('T','C',855,563); atom('U','C',960,622); bond('NMe','T'); bond('T','U')
# indole/central fused core
atom('V','C',1063,438); atom('W','C',1063,560); bond('M','V'); bond('V','W',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('W','U')
atom('Ci','C',1178,598); atom('Di','C',1247,501); atom('H1','C',1364,514); atom('H2','C',1417,624); atom('H3','C',1346,721); atom('H4','C',1225,711); atom('Nind','N',1178,405)
bond('W','Ci'); bond('Ci','Di',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('Di','Nind'); bond('Nind','V')
bond('Di','H1'); bond('H1','H2',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('H2','H3'); bond('H3','H4',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('H4','Ci')
# make mol, initial 2D-derived 3D coordinates, screen y converted to Cartesian y-up
mol=rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(mol)
conf=Chem.Conformer(mol.GetNumAtoms())
for n,i in ids.items():
    x,y=xy[n]
    z=0.0
    # solid wedge at A to aryl P2; hashed carbonyl wedge away
    if n=='P2': z=1.0
    if n=='CO': z=-1.0
    # hashed ethynyl bond at F
    if n=='Q': z=-1.0
    conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(x*0.01,-y*0.01,z))
mol.AddConformer(conf)
# Add all explicit hydrogens, with coordinates
mol=Chem.AddHs(mol,addCoords=True)
# position stereochem-bearing H atoms per drawing conventions
for center,z in [('I',-1.0),('M',-1.0),('F',1.0)]:
    ci=ids[center]
    hids=[a.GetIdx() for a in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(ci).GetNeighbors() if a.GetSymbol()=='H']
    assert len(hids)==1,(center,hids)
    p=mol.GetConformer().GetAtomPosition(ci)
    mol.GetConformer().SetAtomPosition(hids[0],Point3D(p.x,p.y,z))
# Need structure-based atom tags from 3D wedge semantics
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(mol,confId=0,replaceExistingTags=True)
target={ids[n] for n in ['A','I','F','M']}
for a in mol.GetAtoms():
    if a.GetIdx() not in target:
        a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('stereo targets:')
for n in ['A','I','F','M']:
    a=mol.GetAtomWithIdx(ids[n]); print(n,a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '-')
# Remove sketch conformer, embed an optimized 3D geometry preserving tags
mol.RemoveAllConformers()
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=202503; params.maxIterations=1000
params.useSmallRingTorsions=True
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol,params)
if res!=0: raise RuntimeError('embedding failed')
# Optimize with MMFF (fallback UFF)
if AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(mol):
    ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mol,AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mol))
    ff.Minimize(maxIts=1000)
else: AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(mol,maxIters=1000)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('final stereocenters',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol,includeUnassigned=True,includeCIP=True))
# Write standard xyz all atoms explicit
conf=mol.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{mol.GetNumAtoms()}\nGenerated from mol_0123.png\n')
    for a in mol.GetAtoms():
        p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
        f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
print('wrote',mol.GetNumAtoms(),'atoms')

import runpy
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
# Save optimized xyz values
lines=open('xtb_opt.xyz').read().splitlines(); xyz=[list(map(float,l.split()[1:])) for l in lines[2:]]
d=runpy.run_path('make_127.py')
m=d['m']; conf=m.GetConformer()
for i,(x,y,z) in enumerate(xyz): conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(x,y,z))
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m,confId=0,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('xTB geometry stereocenters:',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m,includeUnassigned=True,includeCIP=True))
PY
